# Every /api route handler the Next.js tier served (method + path), generated
# from web/src/app/api/**/route.ts at the commit that removed it (ADR-0091).
# routes_test.go asserts the gateway registers exactly this set.
# A "# retired: METHOD PATH" line is a route that tier carried but that no
# fleet backend ever served; the gateway deliberately does NOT register it
# (it answers the JSON 404), and routes_test.go asserts that too.
